scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:tests
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend && npm run format:tests
scripts.audit: npm run audit:backend && npm run audit:frontend
scripts.audit:fix: npm run audit:fix:backend && npm run audit:fix:frontend
scripts.stack:up: APP_VERSION=$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD) docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up --build -d --wait
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile test up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from unit unit
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile test up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from integration integration
scripts.test:e2e: ENABLE_E2E_AUTH_BYPASS=1 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile test up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from e2e e2e
scripts.test:e2e:fast: ENABLE_E2E_AUTH_BYPASS=1 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile test up --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from e2e e2e
